banks.reason: Both credit-event text pointers and the whole UTF-16LE pool decode and rebuild. Numeric event types are untouched; zero-capacity allocations stay read-only.
Title, historical description, objective and date are fixed-span editable. Team selectors and scenario state stay read-only.
Lookup records index a UTF-16LE pool by code-unit offset. Pool allocations are fixed-span editable; ids, record order and pool starts do not move.
Lookup records index a UTF-16LE pool by code-unit offset. Pool allocations are fixed-span editable; ids, record order and pool starts do not move.
Seven display pointers per question decode and rebuild; answer keys and progress state are untouched.

excluded_kinds.NAME: 160-byte player-name-atlas metric tables, not user text
excluded_kinds.ROST: roster identity, owned by the bounded roster writer

reason_codes.fixed_allocation_aliased: Fixed allocation. Editing this updates every record that shares it; see reference_count.
reason_codes.fixed_allocation_sole_owner: Fixed allocation with a single owning record.
reason_codes.situ_display_string: This display string has a unique fixed allocation and a display-only consumer. Scenario state is unchanged.
reason_codes.situ_team_selector: This is a team-resource selector consumed by scenario lookup, not display copy; its lookup constraints are not proved, so it stays read-only.
reason_codes.terminator_only: This allocation holds only its terminator, so no nonempty text fits inside it.
reason_codes.triv_display_field: Category, subject, question and the four answers each own a unique fixed allocation. The numeric correct-answer key is not touched.
